added.summary: The publish engine boots on a smaller primary wasm; physics, story, nav, motion, destruction and video are separate modules on the engine version's CDN directory. The modules a game references download beside the primary during the loading screen, the rest on their first call, and og-build.json records them under `modules`. `--modules local` copies them into the output for an offline or self-hosted build; otherwise the page's Content-Security-Policy must allow `connect-src https://origingame.ai`.
